title: Credit Risk Model & Early Warning Dashboard
subtitle: Probability of Default, Risk Grades & SHAP Explanations
description: An end-to-end credit scoring model that decides whether to approve, review or reject a borrower, and flags existing borrowers before they default. Built on 150,000 borrowers from the public Give Me Some Credit dataset.
highlights: Logistic regression scored 0.854 test AUC against XGBoost's 0.861 — close enough that a bank can choose a fully transparent scorecard.
Risk grades A–E separate cleanly — 1.1% actual default in grade A rising to 36.8% in grade E, where 10% of borrowers hold ~55% of defaults.

title: Vehicle Route Tracking System
subtitle: Checkpoint Transit Logging & Interactive Route Playback
status: Deployed at PT Sumatera Prima Fibreboard
description: A tracking application monitoring 10–20 company trucks per day across 4 checkpoints, turning informal radio check-ins into structured records of departure time, trip duration and stop locations.
highlights: Trips are looked up by ticket ID and replayed on an interactive Leaflet map, with start and end capture images stored alongside each record.
Gave logistics managers real departure and dwell-time data in place of estimates, improving visibility across the factory gates.

title: ALC Learning — Learning Management System
subtitle: Grades, Attendance & Exercises for ~100 Students
description: A Learning Management System built and deployed for Alpha Omega Learning Center, supporting academic assessments, daily exercises and learning modules, and tracking daily grades for around 100 students.
highlights: Production system built with Express.js and a relational database, maintained through testing, deployment and ongoing iteration.
A newer Next.js and Supabase build (private source) adds teacher authentication, class grouping, quiz and bonus scoring, attendance records and a class leaderboard.
Row-level security scopes every query to the signed-in teacher, so one teacher cannot read another's students.
